summary.intent: Complete Phase 22 of a performance baseline initiative by instrumenting SDK functions, creating E2E journey timing tests, and establishing load test thresholds with a capacity model.
summary.outcome: All 3 plans (22-01, 22-02, 22-03) were completed and verified with 9/9 must-haves passing; roadmap and state files were updated and changes committed.

repo: Performance instrumentation is environment-gated via PERF_ENABLED flag, suggesting a pattern of opt-in observability
Load test scenarios are structured as 5 distinct scenarios with threshold checking integrated at the module level
E2E journey baselines use PENDING markers as placeholders until real measurements are captured
Planning artifacts live under .planning/phases/<phase-name>/ with VERIFICATION.md, ROADMAP.md, and STATE.md as standard phase lifecycle files

code.finding: Exports withPerf, markStart, markEnd — environment-gated performance API wrapper
Verification artifact created as part of phase completion protocol

workflow: Phase execution follows a wave-based plan structure with spot-checks before a final agent-driven verification pass
Spot-checks verify SUMMARY existence, key file presence, and commit confirmation before marking plans complete
A dedicated verification agent checks must-haves (9/9 in this case) as a gate before updating roadmap/state

open_items: E2E journey baselines contain PENDING markers — real timing measurements need to be captured to replace them
Capacity model scaling recommendations and growth projections exist as documentation but may need validation against live load data
